title: Adjectives and adverbs - Complete comparison and modification system

options.answer: She runs more faster than her brother.
She runs faster than her brother.
She runs most fast than her brother.

explanation.en: Use the comparative form 'faster' without 'more' for one-syllable adjectives and adverbs ending in -er.
explanation.ru: Используйте сравнительную форму 'faster' без 'more' для односложных прилагательных и наречий с окончанием -er.
explanation.uz: Bir bo'g'inli sifat va ravishlar uchun 'more' so'zisiz 'faster' taqqoslash formasini ishlating.

options.answer: This is the most beautiful garden I have ever seen.
This is the more beautiful garden I have ever seen.
This is the beautifulest garden I have ever seen.

explanation.en: Use superlative form 'most beautiful' for adjectives with three or more syllables, not 'more' or incorrect '-est' ending.
explanation.ru: Используйте превосходную форму 'most beautiful' для прилагательных с тремя и более слогами, а не 'more' или неправильное окончание '-est'.
explanation.uz: Uch yoki undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun 'most beautiful' orttirma darajasini ishlating, 'more' yoki noto'g'ri '-est' qo'shimchasini emas.

options.answer: He speaks very careful in meetings.
He speaks very carefully in meetings.
He speaks very carefuly in meetings.

explanation.en: Use adverbs to modify verbs. 'Carefully' is the correct adverb form of 'careful', and it modifies how he speaks.
explanation.ru: Используйте наречия для изменения глаголов. 'Carefully' - правильная наречная форма от 'careful', она изменяет способ речи.
explanation.uz: Fe'llarni o'zgartirish uchun ravishlardan foydalaning. 'Carefully' - 'careful' so'zining to'g'ri ravish shakli, u gapirish usulini bildiradi.

options.answer: She is the older of the three sisters.
She is the eldest of the three sisters.
She is the more old of the three sisters.

explanation.en: Use superlative form 'eldest' when comparing three or more people, not comparative 'older' which is for comparing two people.
explanation.ru: Используйте превосходную форму 'eldest' при сравнении трёх или более людей, а не сравнительную 'older', которая для сравнения двух людей.
explanation.uz: Uch yoki undan ko'p odamni solishtirganda 'eldest' orttirma darajasini ishlating, ikki kishini solishtirishda qo'llaniladigan 'older' ni emas.

options.answer: The weather is getting more worse every day.
The weather is getting worse every day.
The weather is getting worser every day.

explanation.en: 'Worse' is the irregular comparative form of 'bad'. Do not use 'more worse' or 'worser'.
explanation.ru: 'Worse' - неправильная сравнительная форма от 'bad'. Не используйте 'more worse' или 'worser'.
explanation.uz: 'Worse' - 'bad' so'zining tartibsiz taqqoslash shakli. 'More worse' yoki 'worser' ishlatmang.

options.answer: This exercise is much more easier than the last one.
This exercise is much easier than the last one.
This exercise is much more easy than the last one.

explanation.en: Use 'easier' (comparative + -er) for two-syllable adjectives ending in -y, not 'more easier' or 'more easy'.
explanation.ru: Используйте 'easier' (сравнительная + -er) для двусложных прилагательных, оканчивающихся на -y, а не 'more easier' или 'more easy'.
explanation.uz: -y bilan tugagan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun 'easier' (taqqoslash + -er) ni ishlating, 'more easier' yoki 'more easy' ni emas.

options.answer: She arrived earliest than expected.
She arrived earlier than expected.
She arrived more early than expected.

explanation.en: Use comparative 'earlier' when comparing two things with 'than'. 'Earliest' is superlative and 'more early' is incorrect.
explanation.ru: Используйте сравнительную форму 'earlier' при сравнении двух вещей с 'than'. 'Earliest' - превосходная степень, а 'more early' неправильно.
explanation.uz: 'Than' bilan ikki narsani solishtirganda 'earlier' taqqoslash shaklini ishlating. 'Earliest' orttirma daraja, 'more early' esa noto'g'ri.

options.answer: He works hardly to support his family.
He works hard to support his family.
He works very hardly to support his family.

explanation.en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb. 'Hardly' means 'scarcely' or 'barely', not 'with great effort'.
explanation.ru: 'Hard' функционирует как прилагательное и наречие. 'Hardly' означает 'едва' или 'с трудом', а не 'с большим усилием'.
explanation.uz: 'Hard' ham sifat, ham ravish vazifasini bajaradi. 'Hardly' 'zo'rg'a' yoki 'deyarli emas' degan ma'noni bildiradi, 'katta harakat bilan' emas.

options.answer: This is the more expensive car in the showroom.
This is the most expensive car in the showroom.
This is the expensivest car in the showroom.

explanation.en: Use superlative 'most expensive' when comparing one thing to all others in a group, not comparative 'more expensive'.
explanation.ru: Используйте превосходную степень 'most expensive' при сравнении одной вещи со всеми другими в группе, а не сравнительную 'more expensive'.
explanation.uz: Bir narsani guruhdagi barcha boshqalar bilan solishtirganda 'most expensive' orttirma darajasini ishlating, 'more expensive' taqqoslashni emas.

options.answer: She sings beautiful at the concert.
She sings beautifully at the concert.
She sings very beautiful at the concert.

explanation.en: Use adverbs to modify verbs. 'Beautifully' is the adverb form that modifies how she sings, not the adjective 'beautiful'.
explanation.ru: Используйте наречия для изменения глаголов. 'Beautifully' - наречная форма, которая изменяет то, как она поёт, а не прилагательное 'beautiful'.
explanation.uz: Fe'llarni o'zgartirish uchun ravishlardan foydalaning. 'Beautifully' - uning qanday qo'shiq aytishini bildiruvchi ravish shakli, 'beautiful' sifati emas.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with the correct comparative form: My house is ___ (big) than yours.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение правильной сравнительной формой: My house is ___ (big) than yours.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'g'ri taqqoslash shakli bilan to'ldiring: My house is ___ (big) than yours.

options.answer: bigger

explanation.en: For one-syllable adjectives, add -er for comparative form. 'Big' becomes 'bigger' with doubled final consonant.
explanation.ru: Для односложных прилагательных добавляйте -er для сравнительной формы. 'Big' становится 'bigger' с удвоенной последней согласной.
explanation.uz: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun taqqoslash shakli uchun -er qo'shimchasini qo'shing. 'Big' so'zi oxirgi undosh ikki marta yozilgan holda 'bigger' bo'ladi.

prompt.en: Fill in the gap with the correct superlative form: This is the ___ (interesting) book I have ever read.
prompt.ru: Заполните пропуск правильной превосходной формой: This is the ___ (interesting) book I have ever read.
prompt.uz: Bo'shliqni to'g'ri orttirma daraja bilan to'ldiring: This is the ___ (interesting) book I have ever read.

options.answer: most interesting

explanation.en: For adjectives with three or more syllables, use 'most' + adjective for superlative form.
explanation.ru: Для прилагательных с тремя или более слогами используйте 'most' + прилагательное для превосходной степени.
explanation.uz: Uch yoki undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun orttirma daraja shakli uchun 'most' + sifat ishlatiladi.

prompt.en: Complete with the correct adverb form: She drives very ___ (careful).
prompt.ru: Дополните правильной наречной формой: She drives very ___ (careful).
prompt.uz: To'g'ri ravish shakli bilan to'ldiring: She drives very ___ (careful).

options.answer: carefully

explanation.en: To form adverbs from adjectives ending in -ful, add -ly. 'Careful' becomes 'carefully'.
explanation.ru: Для образования наречий от прилагательных, оканчивающихся на -ful, добавьте -ly. 'Careful' становится 'carefully'.
explanation.uz: -ful bilan tugagan sifatlardan ravish yasash uchun -ly qo'shimchasini qo'shing. 'Careful' so'zi 'carefully' bo'ladi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blank with the correct comparative form: Today is ___ (cold) than yesterday.
prompt.ru: Заполните пропуск правильной сравнительной формой: Today is ___ (cold) than yesterday.
prompt.uz: Bo'shliqni to'g'ri taqqoslash shakli bilan to'ldiring: Today is ___ (cold) than yesterday.

options.answer: colder

explanation.en: For one-syllable adjectives, add -er for comparative form. 'Cold' becomes 'colder'.
explanation.ru: Для односложных прилагательных добавляйте -er для сравнительной формы. 'Cold' становится 'colder'.
explanation.uz: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun taqqoslash shakli uchun -er qo'shimchasini qo'shing. 'Cold' so'zi 'colder' bo'ladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with the irregular comparative: This situation is ___ (bad) than before.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение неправильной сравнительной формой: This situation is ___ (bad) than before.
prompt.uz: Gapni tartibsiz taqqoslash shakli bilan to'ldiring: This situation is ___ (bad) than before.

options.answer: worse

explanation.en: 'Bad' has the irregular comparative form 'worse'. Do not use 'badder' or 'more bad'.
explanation.ru: 'Bad' имеет неправильную сравнительную форму 'worse'. Не используйте 'badder' или 'more bad'.
explanation.uz: 'Bad' so'zining tartibsiz taqqoslash shakli 'worse'. 'Badder' yoki 'more bad' ishlatmang.

prompt.en: Fill in the gap with the correct superlative: She is the ___ (good) student in the class.
prompt.ru: Заполните пропуск правильной превосходной формой: She is the ___ (good) student in the class.
prompt.uz: Bo'shliqni to'g'ri orttirma daraja bilan to'ldiring: She is the ___ (good) student in the class.

options.answer: best

explanation.en: 'Good' has the irregular superlative form 'best'. Do not use 'goodest' or 'most good'.
explanation.ru: 'Good' имеет неправильную превосходную форму 'best'. Не используйте 'goodest' или 'most good'.
explanation.uz: 'Good' so'zining tartibsiz orttirma daraja shakli 'best'. 'Goodest' yoki 'most good' ishlatmang.

prompt.en: Complete with the correct comparative: This task is ___ (easy) than I expected.
prompt.ru: Дополните правильной сравнительной формой: This task is ___ (easy) than I expected.
prompt.uz: To'g'ri taqqoslash shakli bilan to'ldiring: This task is ___ (easy) than I expected.

options.answer: easier

explanation.en: For two-syllable adjectives ending in -y, change y to i and add -er. 'Easy' becomes 'easier'.
explanation.ru: Для двусложных прилагательных, оканчивающихся на -y, замените y на i и добавьте -er. 'Easy' становится 'easier'.
explanation.uz: -y bilan tugagan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlarda y ni i ga o'zgartirib, -er qo'shing. 'Easy' so'zi 'easier' bo'ladi.

prompt.en: Fill in the blank with the correct adverb: He speaks English ___ (fluent).
prompt.ru: Заполните пропуск правильным наречием: He speaks English ___ (fluent).
prompt.uz: Bo'shliqni to'g'ri ravish bilan to'ldiring: He speaks English ___ (fluent).

options.answer: fluently

explanation.en: To form adverbs from most adjectives, add -ly. 'Fluent' becomes 'fluently' to modify the verb 'speaks'.
explanation.ru: Для образования наречий от большинства прилагательных добавьте -ly. 'Fluent' становится 'fluently' для изменения глагола 'speaks'.
explanation.uz: Ko'pchilik sifatlardan ravish yasash uchun -ly qo'shimchasini qo'shing. 'Fluent' so'zi 'speaks' fe'lini o'zgartirish uchun 'fluently' bo'ladi.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with the correct superlative: This is the ___ (far) I have ever traveled.
prompt.ru: Дополните предложение правильной превосходной формой: This is the ___ (far) I have ever traveled.
prompt.uz: Gapni to'g'ri orttirma daraja bilan to'ldiring: This is the ___ (far) I have ever traveled.

options.answer: farthest/furthest

explanation.en: 'Far' has two superlative forms: 'farthest' (for physical distance) and 'furthest' (for abstract distance). Both are acceptable here.
explanation.ru: 'Far' имеет две превосходные формы: 'farthest' (для физического расстояния) и 'furthest' (для абстрактного расстояния). Обе приемлемы здесь.
explanation.uz: 'Far' so'zining ikkita orttirma daraja shakli bor: 'farthest' (jismoniy masofa uchun) va 'furthest' (mavhum masofa uchun). Ikkalasi ham bu yerda qabul qilinadigan.

prompt.en: Fill in the gap with the correct comparative: She works ___ (hard) than anyone else.
prompt.ru: Заполните пропуск правильной сравнительной формой: She works ___ (hard) than anyone else.
prompt.uz: Bo'shliqni to'g'ri taqqoslash shakli bilan to'ldiring: She works ___ (hard) than anyone else.

options.answer: harder

explanation.en: 'Hard' as an adverb forms comparative with -er. Do not confuse with 'hardly' which has a different meaning.
explanation.ru: 'Hard' как наречие образует сравнительную форму с -er. Не путайте с 'hardly', которое имеет другое значение.
explanation.uz: 'Hard' ravish sifatida -er bilan taqqoslash shaklini hosil qiladi. Boshqa ma'noga ega bo'lgan 'hardly' bilan adashtirmang.
